chess.hook: Every titled chess coach in the country, findable — and their FIDE title finally worth something.
assoc_wins: The title earns its keep
A FIDE Trainer title currently means something only to other chess players. Here it is a badge the parent of a beginner can see — and a straight reason to keep the title current.
Parents can tell a coach from a hobbyist
A parent searching “chess coach” today has no way to tell them apart. Ranked by credential, the titled coach is the one they see first.
Nobody is exposed
CHESSA sends no list and we ask for none. No coach's name, number or address is published.
chess.extra: We already hold a verified public registry of 4,237 FIDE trainers, so the title check is a lookup, not paperwork.

judo.hook: Every graded judo coach in the province, findable — and their dan grade and coaching licence finally worth something.

cards.title: Judo — juniors, gradings and competition squad

proposed: Dan grade verified against the JSA register
assoc_wins: A licence a parent can actually see
A JSA coaching licence sits in a file. Here it is the thing that puts a licensed coach above an unlicensed one in a public search.
Safeguarding becomes visible
Judo is a contact sport taught to children. Police clearance and safeguarding are already scored signals — the coaches who have them are the ones parents find first.
Nobody is exposed
JSA sends no list and we ask for none. A coach who wants nothing to do with it simply does nothing.

athletics.hook: Every coach at your affiliated clubs, findable by the runners who are looking for exactly them.

cards.title: Track coaching, sprints and middle distance

assoc_wins: Clubs get found without paying for it
A club has no advertising budget and no reason to have one. This costs the club nothing and the province nothing.
Better privacy than today
Your club officers' cell numbers are published on your own website right now — that is how we found them. Nothing of theirs is published with us.
The licence becomes a reason to hold it
A coaching licence that shows up in a public search is a licence worth renewing.

plumbers.assoc_full: the Institute of Plumbing South Africa
plumbers.hook: Every PIRB-licensed plumber in the suburb, findable — and ranked above the cowboys.
assoc_wins: Nothing needs building — it is all live today
PIRB licence, IOPSA registration, trade certificate and public liability insurance are ALREADY scored signals. An IOPSA member can list tonight and rank above an unlicensed operator immediately.
The cowboy problem, addressed by ranking
The public phones whoever appears first. Here the licensed, insured plumber IS the one who appears first — which is the outcome IOPSA exists to push.
Nobody is exposed
IOPSA sends no list and we ask for none. No member's name, number or address is published.
plumbers.extra: This is the strongest case of the set: every credential IOPSA issues or requires is already on our live scoring list. Nothing has to be added.

teachers.assoc_full: the teacher unions and subject associations
teachers.hook: Your members are already qualified, already registered, already police-cleared. On TrustSquare that paperwork is worth R200 to R500 an hour after school — and it costs them nothing to find out.

cards.title: Maths & Physical Science, Gr 10–12, exam prep

assoc_wins: It is money in your members' pockets, not ours

A teacher sets their own rate and keeps every rand of it. We take no commission and no share of the lesson fee — ever. The free account carries two listings at R0, with no card and no trial. The only fee on the platform is paid by the PARENT, once, to be introduced.
The qualification finally pays

An Honours degree, SACE registration and fifteen years in a classroom currently earn a teacher nothing extra after 3pm. Here they are the badges that put a member at 95 — above every unqualified 'homework helper' charging R180 an hour.
Repeat pupils cost nothing more
The introduction is a one-off. Once a parent and a teacher are introduced they deal with each other directly, for as many terms as they like. A regular pupil is never charged for twice.
Nothing needs building on our side
Every credential a teacher holds is ALREADY a scored signal. A member can list tonight and rank correctly in the morning.
Nobody is exposed, and that matters more here

No teacher's name, school, address or phone number is published. A teacher tutoring privately after hours stays anonymous until they choose to accept an enquiry — which is the difference between this and putting a notice on a Facebook group.
teachers.extra: Worked illustration, not a promise: a teacher taking four pupils for two hours a week at R350 an hour earns about R2,800 a week, R11,200 a month, and keeps all of it. What they pay us is nothing.
